mechanics_notes: 1) PARTY UTILITY RIDER: Wind Fury Sun Shower provides meaningful party buffs (+12% AS+MS) — not negligible, but these are riders on a DPS identity, not the primary function. Aeromancer is classified as DPS, not support. The party buffing is a bonus, not the reason to bring Aeromancer to a raid. 2) UMBRELLA CHAIN MECHANIC: the +12% meter per chained umbrella use creates a specific skill-ordering requirement — the Aeromancer must fire umbrella skills in rapid succession (not interleaved with other skill types) to maximize meter generation. This is a sequencing optimization not visible from raw skill data. 3) SUN SHOWER FLOAT: pressing Spacebar during Sun Shower converts to Float (early cancel) rather than the standard dash spacebar. This changes the mobility profile during identity window — intentional exit via Float rather than standard dodge. 4) WIND FURY vs DRIZZLE DESIGN: Wind Fury = fast umbrella melee for frequent short Sun Shower windows; Drizzle = slow ranged Weather Skills for long extended Sun Shower windows. Classic burst-melee vs sustained-ranged fork in different weapon modes.
stabilization_patch: Wind Fury has been the preferred Aeromancer identity for close-range players; Drizzle for ranged preference.

mechanics_notes: 1) DRIZZLE IS THE RANGED SPECIALIST for the Aeromancer pair: Wind Fury = melee umbrella chain; Drizzle = ranged weather ranged. Two entirely different weapon modes define the identity fork. 2) 9% PARTY SHIELD + -10% ENEMY ATTACK: Drizzle's Sun Shower party debuff/shield are more impactful than Wind Fury's AS/MS buff for survivability-focused raid contexts. These buffs are still riders on a DPS identity, but Drizzle Aeromancer has the stronger 'accidental support' profile of the two. 3) 24-SECOND SUN SHOWER: one of the longest identity windows in LA. Provides significant margin for full skill rotation within a single Sun Shower. More forgiving than Wind Fury's short window. 4) NON-POSITIONAL ranged = safest LA DPS playstyle tier: no back-attack requirement, ranged from 15-30m, stationary zone effects. Drizzle has low execution floor. 5) DRIZZLE vs WIND FURY META: both are approximately equivalent tier (Drizzle slightly preferred for safe content; Wind Fury for mobile content where close-range umbrella works).
